name: Blackstone Inc.
blurb: Blackstone Inc. is a leading global alternative asset management firm specializing in private equity, real estate, credit, and hedge fund solutions. With over $1 trillion in assets under management, it is one of the largest and most influential investment firms in the world. The company serves institutional and individual investors through a diversified range of investment strategies.
recent: As of May 7, 2026, Blackstone's stock closed at $122.33, down 1.89% on the day, with a market cap of approximately $150.5 billion. The company reported earnings on April 23, 2026, showing revenue of $14.40 billion (up 16.4% year-over-year) and net income of $3.05 billion (up 20.1%). The stock has a 52-week range of $101.73 to $190.09 and an analyst price target of $156.53.
